about: Custom types P3: the boot cell of harness_type_gcell names newt (map mod harness_map_type) and carries a mon_spr_newt set; harness_type_gpatch (map harness_t) patches its mon_placements with newt. After a menu load of a harness_t save the patch runs in the deferred load, after newt exists, and resolves the pending cell: the cell must also get its own boot mon_spr_newt set then (the recheck skips a cell that is no longer pending).

steps.why: quit to menu, then load the save: the map mods (and the patch) load in the deferred load

steps.name: gnx_scn_cell_has_set
steps.why: the boot set of newt, replayed by the patch that resolved the cell
